```plato
//==
// # Texturing interfaces
//
// The abstraction behind procedural texturing: a pattern that answers with a
// color at any UV coordinate, instead of storing texels. The concrete
// procedural textures that implement it live in `texturing.types.plato`.

// A pattern evaluated directly at a UV coordinate instead of stored texels.
// Implementations are resolution-independent and infinitely tileable unless
// documented otherwise. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Procedural_texture)
interface IProceduralTexture
    inherits IValue
{
    ColorAt(x: Self, uv: UvCoordinate): Color;
}
```
